question: Should gateway JSON message/reason fields become locale-dependent as part of this runtime i18n PR, or should those protocol-adjacent fields stay stable while only display surfaces localize?
rationale: The diff changes gateway-facing message/reason strings that may be consumed by clients, and repository policy treats protocol and upgrade-sensitive surfaces as maintainer decisions when compatibility is unclear.

options.title: Keep Protocol-Adjacent Fields Stable
options.body: Localize chat/UI display copy but preserve gateway JSON message/reason strings unless a separate protocol/display contract is approved.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Display Fields
options.body: Treat existing gateway code/type fields as the stable contract and allow message/reason strings to follow the selected locale after broader compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol-Adjacent Fields Stable
recommendation.body: Localize chat/UI display copy but preserve gateway JSON message/reason strings unless a separate protocol/display contract is approved.
